signals.topic: Candid rescue & bonding animal moments (short video)
signals.summary: Short vertical videos of emotional, candid animal moments — strays adopting families, terrified rescues taking a first step, a cat that won't give up her cone. The category's signature 'candid over polished' format.
signals.why_now: 6 fresh The Dodo videos in the last 24h: 'Neighbor's Dog Basically Adopted This Family 3 Years Ago' (0.2h), 'Cat Refuses To Give Up Her Cone 13 Years After Surgery' (2.2h), 'Woman Tries To Save Vacation Stray' (16.2h), 'Terrified Dog Evades Rescuers For Three Straight Days' (20.2h), 'Abandoned Premature Foal Finds A Mare' (22.2h), 'Terrified Foster Dog Takes His First Step Outside' (24.2h). CAVEAT: all six are one source (yt:thedodo); with Reddit down this run there is no independent cross-source visual confirmation, so velocity evidence is thin.

signals.topic: Cat body-language & behaviour explainers ('why does my cat do X')
signals.summary: An evergreen vein of 'decode your cat' explainers — stress signs, zoomies, head-rubbing, laptop-sitting, eye signals — each pinned to an illustrable candid cat behaviour.
signals.why_now: Large cross-source cluster, though mostly evergreen/older: 'Signs your cat is stressed' (Independent, 47.4h) is the only sub-48h item; supported by 'Why Do Cats Get the Zoomies?' (PetMD), 'Why Is My Cat Rubbing Her Head on Everything?' (Spruce Pets), 'Why your cat loves sitting on your laptop' (BBC), 'Why you're probably stroking your cat wrong' (BBC), 'What Are My Cat's Eyes Telling Me?' (Spruce Pets), 'Is your cat loud or quiet? It could be in their genes' (RTE, 222h). Steady genre, not a spiking wave — velocity is low.

signals.summary: The 'catio' — a leafy screened outdoor patio giving indoor cats safe fresh-air access — as a summer well-being trend. Highly illustrable: a cat lounging in a green enclosed garden space.
signals.why_now: Three independent sources frame catios / outdoor access as a growing pet trend: 'One Brooklyn cat owner's catio reflects growing pet care trend' (Brooklyn Paper), 'Why catios are great for your cat's well-being — and how to build one' (CBC), and 'Outdoor Access May Benefit Cats, Study Shows' (Psychology Today). CAVEAT: all three items are old (1000h–2670h); kept only under the seasonal (summer/outdoor) evergreen exemption — essentially zero live velocity this run.
